title: Support independent position content
description: Allow a sheet position assignment to reference independent serializable rich content instead of a shared template while preserving one explicit assignment union.
acceptanceCriteria: PositionAssignment discriminates template-instance and independent-content variants
Independent assignments reference or contain only versioned serializable application-owned content
Independent content requires no template identity or template data map
Template and independent assignments can coexist in one project without ambiguous resolution
Malformed mixed variants are refused with assignment-specific diagnostics

steps.details: Add an independent-content variant to PositionAssignment using the existing rich content identity/schema and mutually exclusive discriminants.
Route the independent variant directly through rich-content validation and shared scene resolution without inventing a template or data binding.
Update project parsing and persistence so both assignment variants retain stable identities and reject records containing fields from both variants.
Round-trip a project containing one template instance and one independent assignment and assert deterministic resolution and malformed-union diagnostics.

technicalNotes: Keep this task under ten minutes by reusing TASK-35 rich content validation and adding only the assignment variant.
Do not flatten template instances to implement coexistence.
